steps.content: Chief! What a coincidence! Didn't expect to see you here!
From the intersection up ahead, a young girl came skipping toward you, calling out a bright greeting.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What brings you out here?

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: You know, the whole bureau's been working overtime for the recent Marauders cases.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Then I got a field assignment, and it just happened to be around here.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Didn't expect to run into you two wrapping up! So, how'd it go? Any leads?
Wynn rattles on without pause, her gaze blinking from you to the speechless Eugene at your side.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Ah... Well, these things happen, right? No luck this time, but there's always next!
In a deliberate attempt to lighten the mood, Wynn scratches her cheek and exaggerates her tone before nudging Eugene with her elbow.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...Yeah. We'll catch them.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Since we've run into each other, why don't you join us for coffee, Wynn?

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Oh?! You're treating, Chief? Count me in!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So you won't say no this time, right?
Eugene's ears flush red the moment he catches your teasing look. He nods, nonetheless, and falls into step.
Oh? Customers this early?
Welcome!
Good morning! Welcome to Cat's Eye!
As the door opens, the soft aroma of coffee wafts through the air. Behind a stylish yet cozy counter, three stunning women welcome you with warm smiles.
Come, have a seat!
We've got lots of coffees to choose from. Take your time!
If you have a preferred bean or flavor, just let me know. We'll do our best to match it.
If you're interested, our signature pancakes pair wonderfully with coffee.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: O-okay, thank you for having us...

After a long and tense night of pursuit, stepping into the café feels like entering another world. The sweet, rich aroma of coffee wraps around you. As the three enthusiastic staff members welcome you warmly, the knots of tension in your shoulders begin to loosen.
Wynn and Eugene are ushered into seats beside you, their gazes immediately lifting to the menu board, scanning its slightly crooked handwriting with open curiosity.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm not picky about beans. Something with a strong roast, please. And an extra shot.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Hmm... I'll have a latte! Mornings call for something milky!

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Ahem, I'll... I'll have the same as Chief.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: The same as Chief?
With a furrowed brow aimed at Eugene, Wynn leans in close to whisper.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Chief's coffee is so bitter, you'd have to have been eating candy since the DisSea Explosion to balance it out. You really sure about this?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I can hear you, you know.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Wow, the coffee here smells AMAZING!

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Miss Shop Owner—er, Founder? Is it the new trendy word now? Anyway, you're all so impressive!
In the nearly empty space, Wynn's endearingly clumsy subject change earns a round of quiet chuckles. The easy atmosphere draws two of the staff members over to join your conversation.
Hehe, my sister's coffee really is the best!

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Oh, you're sisters? Now that you mention it, you do look alike!

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: That's right! This is my big sister, Kisugi Rui, and my second sister, Kisugi Hitomi!

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: And I'm Kisugi Ai!
As Wynn and the other girl—near in age—gather close, their presence feels like little rays of sunshine, instantly easing the fatigue from your sleepless night.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Please don't mind our little sister. She can be quite the chatterbox.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: She's just very curious and loves talking to people.
Kisugi Rui sets a cup of aromatic coffee before you, offering an apologetic smile. Yet her gaze softens with clear affection as it finds her little sister.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Not at all. It's refreshing to see such liveliness.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: So much energy every day can be a handful sometimes!

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Hitomi!
Kisugi Ai's cheeks puff out in a show of feigned indignation, and she shoots her sister a glare.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: You two look rather tired for so early in the morning...

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: ...Must have been working all night...
Kisugi Rui gazes out the window, her chin resting in her hands, a hint of worry gracing her features.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: I've noticed more uniformed personnel like you guys coming and going lately.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Has something... happened recently?

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Gulp... Haven't you seen the news, Miss Rui?
At her words, Wynn swallows her mouthful of pancake in a hurry, waving a hand.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Lately, there's been a group of strange thieves targeting famous artworks in Eastside!

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Oh my... that sounds quite serious...

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: They're incredibly skilled, in and out without a trace. I heard that...
Leaning forward herself, Wynn lowers her voice to a confidential murmur and gestures the others closer.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: That... they might be Sinners, like that dangerous group from before who committed murder!

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: M-murder?!

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: What...? Sinners...
Seeing the three sisters' frightened expressions, Eugene interjects hurriedly, his tone a blend of intimidation and reassurance.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: That's right. Those types will stop at nothing. The people we're after... they might be the same. But I promise you this: we will catch them. And when we do, they'll face the full weight of justice!

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Yeah! So you all...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Ahem. Let's finish up. We still have work to do.
Something feels off, an intangible shift in the air you can't quite name. Heeding your instincts, you decide to drop the subject.
With a final sip of coffee, you offer the sisters a conciliatory smile.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This really was excellent coffee. I'll be sure to return.
Eugene never does finish his coffee. Seeing you near the door, he and Wynn have no choice but to rise and follow.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Chief, wait for me!

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Hitomi, are you certain now?

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Yes, that's him. Without a doubt.
steps.female_content: Yes, that's her. Without a doubt.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: We've been fast enough, but they still showed up here.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: That officer in charge... is sharper than we expected.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Rui! Hitomi! I found it!
On the wall, a projection resolves into the portrait of a gray-haired man. To its side, text runs in dense lines, cataloging his achievements.
steps.female_content: On the wall, a projection resolves into the portrait of a gray-haired woman. To its side, text runs in dense lines, cataloging her achievements.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control, hero of the West District liberation, overseer of Sinners... Quite the impressive record.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: And here, I also pulled the case they mentioned.
As Kisugi Ai clicks the next file, a Sinner's art heist pops up on the screen. The record is chilling: the culprit stole the masterpiece at the cost of the owner's life.
According to the latest intel, the culprit has been identified as a Sinner, but remains at large.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: So... they think we're like that? Vicious criminals?

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: ...It makes sense, I guess.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: It's all right.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: We'll be seeing them often. I'm sure this misunderstanding will clear up in time.
